interpretation_notes: No facility differential applies; Services are delivered from Main Campus (F-MAIN).
All plan tiers are reimbursed identically.
Rounding is half-up to the nearest whole cent after each individual multiplier, premium, or discount step.
Line total is resulting unit rate multiplied by billed quantity.
Amendment No. 1 applies by Service Date; invoice issue date is irrelevant.
ambiguities: The agreement groups threshold premiums and non-business-day uplifts together as step (d) ('any premium or uplift') without specifying their relative sequence when both apply. The listed adjustment order places threshold_premium before weekend_uplift solely for schema ordering; their contractual relative order is not stated.
unsupported_rules: Daily caps are expressly per Patient per Service Day; the schema records the cap quantity and unit but has no field for the cap aggregation scope.

Exclusion-window clauses do not expressly state whether the excluded service is barred when the trigger service occurs on the same Service Day; 'within' is represented as an either-side window but inclusive endpoint treatment is not specified.
The same Service may not be billed twice for the same Patient and Service Date, whether on one invoice or across several.
Every Service Date must fall within the term and may not fall after the invoice date.
Amendment No. 1 does not affect an invoice already settled before 2025-01-01.
